meta.prompt: Show six running shoes as a carousel I can swipe or step through with arrows, with dots and a position like "3 of 6": Aero Runner $120, 4.8 stars; Trail Scout $135, 4.6; Tempo Flash $150, 4.7; Cloud Stride $140, 4.5; Daybreak 2 $95, 4.4; Night Owl $125, 4.6, each with a picture placeholder. Tapping one opens its details in place: its name and price, a description (for Tempo Flash: "A snappy plate and a low stack for intervals and race day."), sizes 7 to 12 to pick (8 is sold out), the chosen size shown as "Size 9" and so on, an Add to bag button, and a way back to the carousel.
meta.text:
state page=0
state open=0
state size=""
state bag=0
state shoes=[{"id":1,"name":"Aero Runner","price":120,"rating":4.8,"kind":"shoe","tone":"sand","detail":"Lightweight daily trainer"},{"id":2,"name":"Trail Scout","price":135,"rating":4.6,"kind":"shoe","tone":"mint","detail":"Grippy trail outsole"},{"id":3,"name":"Tempo Flash","price":150,"rating":4.7,"kind":"shoe","tone":"sky","detail":"A snappy plate and a low stack for intervals and race day.","desc":true},{"id":4,"name":"Cloud Stride","price":140,"rating":4.5,"kind":"shoe","tone":"lilac","detail":"Soft cushioned long-run comfort"},{"id":5,"name":"Daybreak 2","price":95,"rating":4.4,"kind":"shoe","tone":"rose","detail":"Affordable everyday runner"},{"id":6,"name":"Night Owl","price":125,"rating":4.6,"kind":"shoe","tone":"slate","detail":"Reflective panels for night runs"}]

Column
  ChatCard "Running shoes" "Swipe or step through" icon:"directions_run" status:"Shop"
    if open==0
      Carousel =open items:=shoes dots arrows counter height:260 -> open=open
    if open>0
      Text.title "{shoes[open-1].name}"
      Text.strong "${shoes[open-1].price}"
      Paragraph "{shoes[open-1].desc ? shoes[open-1].detail : shoes[open-1].detail}"
      SectionLabel "Size" "pick one"
      ChoiceChips =size options:["7","8","9","10","11","12"] disabled:["8"] columns:3
      if size!=""
        Text.muted "Size {size}"
      Row gap:10
        ActionButton "Back" quiet icon:"arrow_back" -> open=0
        ActionButton "Add to bag" primary icon:"shopping_bag" enabled:=size!="" -> bag=bag+1; toast "Added to bag"
